title: valuation_plan
description: Input plan consumed by valuation_engine.py. The skill/agent gathers data (FMP/Perplexity/SEC/BioMCP), assembles this plan, then runs the engine. Units are millions unless noted; rates are decimals (0.09 = 9%).

wacc.description: Either supply 'wacc' directly, or supply the build inputs and the engine computes it.

crp.description: Country-risk premium (decimal). Widens the validator's acceptable WACC band to 5%–(20%+crp) so legitimate emerging-market discount rates are not flagged.

tax_band.description: Optional [lo, hi] override for the acceptable tax-rate band (default [0.15, 0.30]) for non-US jurisdictions.

dcf.description: Inputs for fcff/fcfe/apv. base_cf = base-year FCFF (fcff/apv) or FCFE (fcfe). FCFE is NEVER discounted at WACC: supply 'rate' (a precomputed cost of equity) or wacc build inputs (rf/erp/beta). APV supply 'rho_u' (unlevered cost of equity) or wacc build inputs so beta can be unlevered; plus tax_shield_pv and optional distress_pv.

rate.description: Precomputed discount rate. For fcfe this is the cost of equity (ke) — the engine hard-errors rather than silently fall back to WACC. For fcff, used only when no built WACC is available.

rho_u.description: APV only: unlevered cost of equity. If omitted, derived by unlevering the wacc-block beta.

roc.description: Stable-phase return on capital (ROIC for fcff/apv, ROE for fcfe). If supplied, the validator checks g = RR × ROC (RR = g/ROC ≤ 1) and warns when ROC ≤ discount rate (value-destroying growth).

tax_shield_pv.description: APV only: PV of interest tax shields, added once explicitly (never embed it in the discount rate).

distress_pv.description: APV only: PV of expected financial-distress/bankruptcy cost, subtracted. Default 0.

drivers.description: Driver-based FCFF (young/high-growth/cyclical firms, Ch.22-23). When present under method=fcff, the engine builds the FCFF stream from revenue→margin→reinvestment instead of base_cf+growth_rates.

current_margin.description: Current operating margin (decimal; may be negative).

margin_converge.description: Fraction of the current→target margin gap closed each year (0.5=LinkedIn, ~0.333=Tesla).

nol.description: Opening NOL carryforward balance; 0% tax until exhausted.

terminal_roc.description: Stable-phase ROC; terminal reinvestment = g/terminal_roc. If omitted, the last explicit FCFF is grown by (1+g).

ddm.description: Dividend Discount Model. Single-stage: supply dps1, ke_stable, stable_growth. Two-stage: supply dps0, high_growth, high_years, ke_high, ke_stable, stable_growth, and — for a payout step-up at the stable transition (Damodaran P&G) — BOTH payout_high and payout_stable so the terminal dividend is earnings-anchored.

payout_high.description: High-phase dividend payout ratio; required with payout_stable to convert DPS_n back to EPS_n.

rf.description: Risk-free rate; activates the g <= rf economic terminal-growth cap on the DDM path.

roc.description: Stable-phase ROE. If omitted but payout_stable is given, derived as g/(1−payout_stable) for the value-creating-growth check.

peak_sales.description: Informational headline only — NOT a present value and never used as pv_commercial.

pv_commercial.description: Required: PV of risk-unadjusted commercial cash flows ($M).

committed.description: Contractually committed program (no right to abandon); overrides floor_zero so a negative rNPV is carried through.

commercial.description: Optional drug commercial-curve drivers to BUILD pv_commercial (risk-UNADJUSTED) instead of hand-supplying it. Risk stays in loa. Ch.28 rNPV foundation.

launch_year.description: First calendar year with sales (years from valuation date).

discount_rate.description: Biotech/asset discount rate (risk goes in loa, not here).

options_value.description: Black-Scholes value of options/warrants ($M), subtracted from equity as a liability; per-share then uses BASIC shares.

basis.description: What target_metric is. EV/* multiples require 'aggregate' (EBITDA/sales, $M). Equity (P/*) multiples need 'per_share' (EPS/BVPS/SPS) or 'aggregate' ($M net income/book equity/sales) — REQUIRED for P/* to avoid a dual-unit order-of-magnitude error.

exclude_outliers.description: Drop Tukey-fence outliers from the central multiple and 25/75 range. Default false = outliers flagged but INCLUDED.
